title: cotton muslin bags
text: cotton muslin bags. Cotton muslin bags - just as described.  They are stiff - but did wash - if you want them crisp again, you'll need press them of course.  They are a beige color.  Draw string closure.  I purchased them for my grandsons to keep their dug up pirate booty found in my sandy front yard.  Works great for that.  I am also going to use a couple in a craft project making tic tac toe boards with rocks.  The bag is the board and storage for the rocks.

product_metadata.title: DR 100 Percent Cotton Muslin Drawstring Bags 6/12/24 Pack For Storage Pantry Gifts Shoes
features: Set of 12 muslin bags with drawstring for parties, weddings, gifts and weddings. Please make sure to order the right size for your project

The exterior size of the bags is 8 x 10 inch. The hem with drawstring is about a half inch from top. The interior size of the bags is approximately 7½ x 9½ inch. Made of all natural 100% cotton in a socially and environmentally manner
These pouches are ideal for wardrobe, kitchen, office, car and tool shed
For storing spices, crafts, soaps, candles, gifts, jars, tools or children’s shoes
Can be used used to store fruits and vegetables in refrigerator. Just dampen the bag and your bagged produce will keep longer in the fridge
